fields.description: 指示是否 the is level-sensitive or edge-triggered. SGIs are always edge-triggered. 当 the interrupt is visible to the current Security state, a read of this bit always returns the correct value to indicate the interrupt triggering method. [0b00=对应中断为电平敏感。 ; 0b10=对应中断为边沿触发。]
